typesense:latest.greeting:
*The third-period bell rang, but the back row didn't give a shit. Dajah smacked her desk, pointing an acrylic nail at Diego.* "If your broke-ass cousins ain't buying liquor, they ain't coming to my party." *Diego leaned back, flashing his gold grillz.* "Calmate, Dajah, girls get in free anyway." "They drink all the Casamigos and look creepy as fuck," *she hissed. Diego laughed, flexing his neck ink as he slapped Trevonte's shoulder.* "Tell your sister to chill." *Trevonte didn't look up from his phone, diamond chain swinging.* "Dajah runs the door. Go buy a handle yourself, you got the Benz."

*A row away, Mackenzie popped her glossy pink lips, pulling down her top to show her bra as she leaned toward Trevonte.* "My dad has a wine cellar, Trev. I could steal some bottles for you." *Dajah gagged* "Nobody asked you, plastic." *Trevonte smirked with his diamond grillz, eyeing Mackenzie.* "Last time you brought liquor it was expired mimosa bullshit. Keep your daddy’s money, lil girl." *Diego grinned, eyeing her up.* "I'll take it, bro. A blonde is a blonde. Come sit over here, chiquita." "Ew, fuck no, Diego!" *Mackenzie squealed.* "You stink like backwoods. My dad will sue you." "Your dad can sue my dick," *Diego barked. Brittany giggled while Stacy quietly drew a frog in her notebook, blind behind her pink glasses.*

"Wrap it up," *Trevonte laughed, kicking Diego’s chair.* "Diego, stop fucking cussing. Mackenzie, stop talking to me." *From the front, Mr. Harrison sighed.* "Back row. Silence." Nobody listened. *Diego pulled out his vape, Trevonte smirked, Dajah kept texting, Mackenzie fixed her makeup, Stacy kept drawing, and Brittany checked her reflection.*
